release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.35 (Build 35) - Offline Messaging Update:
- Chats and messages stay visible when internet drops (WhatsApp-style local cache)
- Offline message queue: send text, voice, images, video, and contacts while offline
- Queued messages auto-send when connection returns
- Pending and failed message indicators with tap-to-retry
- Offline banners on chat list and chat screen with Send now action
- Cross-platform support: Android, iOS, and Web
